title.narrative: Initiative for Heritage Conservation - HerMap

description.narrative: Overall Objective: To support cultural, creative and sports industries outside of the Greater Banjul Area as engines for social and economic development to foster job creation and mitigate irregular migration through the development of Gambian Cultural Heritage Management (CHM).The specific outcomes resulting from these will be: Oc1: Strengthened contribution of the cultural, creative and sport industries to the employability of young people and women e.g. skills development or job creationOc2: Linkages built between cultural, creative and sports industries, SMEs and tourism

description.narrative: Number of developed, signed and operational Memoranda of Understanding

The MoUs facilitate joint initiatives promote resource sharing and align goals among stakeholders thereby strengthening the overall impact of our intervention. The successful completion of this indicator not only exceeds the initial target but also exemplifies the effectiveness of our collaborative approach in enhancing cultural heritage and tourism development.

title.narrative: Number of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) reporting turnover variation as a byproduct of the intervention

description.narrative: Number of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) reporting turnover variation as a byproduct of the intervention

comment.narrative: This indicator measures the number of Micro Small and Medium Enterprises MSMEs that report variations in turnover as a direct result of interventions aimed at enhancing their business capabilities. Over the course of the action a total of 13 MSMEs have reported positive turnover variations.Throughout the intervention period various capacitybuilding initiatives consultations and workshops have been implemented to support MSMEs in integrating cultural heritage into their business practices. These efforts aim to empower enterprises by enhancing their operational strategies product offerings and market appeal. The successful engagement of MSMEs reflects the effectiveness of the intervention in fostering economic growth and sustainability within the local business landscape.

title.narrative: Number of interventiontrained professionals applying acquired CHM knowledge.

description.narrative: Number of interventiontrained professionals applying acquired CHM knowledge.

comment.narrative: Following a comprehensive review of our data the previously reported numbers have been adjusted to reflect the qualitative nature of the application of CHM knowledge. A total of 62 individuals who have participated in various training programs and received individualized or group consultations are now effectively applying their CHM knowledge within their professional contexts.Additionally a delegation mission that undertook a study trip to Greece has not only received training in CHM practices but has also gained practical actionable insights. These trained professionals are expected to implement their newly acquired skills within legislative and operational frameworks thereby contributing to the broader benefit of the country and ensuring the sustainability and success of our CHM initiatives.

title.narrative: Status of national strategy on CHM in the Gambia

description.narrative: Currently there is no National Strategy Plan/ Policy on CHM and tourism for the Gambia. Therefore, and according to the National Development Plan (20182021) CHM strategy is considered being under development and includes the following actions: Increase the amount of funds allocated to the promotion of culture from D4.2million to D10million; Increase the number of upgraded cultural heritage sites from 1 to 3; and Existence of a multipurpose cultural center.

Therefore, and according to the National Development Plan (20182021) CHM strategy is considered being under development and includes the following actions: Increase the amount of funds allocated to the promotion of culture from D4.2million to D10million; Increase the number of upgraded cultural heritage sites from 1 to 3; and Existence of a multipurpose cultural center.
